happy.desc: grep -r KOALA_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS packages/main/src/core/ -> zero hits; WHY: the legacy budget-token fallback is removed from production code

grep -rn KOALA_ packages/main/src/core/ packages/main/src/handlers/ -> zero hits except review-preflight.ts gate wiring; WHY: no orphan KOALA_ reference in production code that could be a latent fallback
